BestGardens

Botanical gardens, formal landscapes and living collections worth planning a day around, though season matters more here than for any other kind of sight. The same garden can be the best thing in the country one month and a set of bare beds six weeks later, so each entry gives the window rather than assuming you will guess it.

Royal Botanic Garden Sydney
Sydney, Australia
Est. 1816
A harbourside botanical garden next to the Opera House, established in 1816 as one of Australia's oldest scientific institutions, with themed gardens and sweeping views of the harbour.
Official site Wikipedia Sydney guide Map
Royal Botanic Gardens Melbourne
Melbourne, Australia
A 19th-century botanical garden beside the Yarra River, laid out in a landscaped style around ornamental lakes, with themed beds and a large collection of plants from around the world.
Official site Wikipedia Melbourne guide Map
Schönbrunn Palace Gardens
Vienna, Austria
UNESCO Site
The Baroque gardens of the former Habsburg summer residence, with symmetrical parterres rising to the Gloriette hilltop pavilion, plus a maze and one of the world's oldest zoos.

Jardim Botânico
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Founded 1808
Rio's botanical garden, founded in the early 19th century, noted for its long avenue of towering royal palms, orchid houses, and collections of Brazilian and tropical plants.

Curitiba, Paraná

A botanical garden set inside the Mata do Buraquinho, roughly 470 hectares of surviving Atlantic rainforest in the middle of João Pessoa and one of the largest urban forest reserves in Brazil.
